issues.description: Field 'numberOfInscribedStudents' has conflicting types across artifacts and causes a compilation error in the solution: the problem statement UML (class Lecture) declares numberOfInscribedStudents as int, while the solution implementation declares private long numberOfInscribedStudents. The solution also implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() with signature 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' but its body returns the sum of numberOfGuestStudents (int) and numberOfInscribedStudents (long), producing a long expression that cannot be returned as int without a cast. This inconsistency (int vs long) confuses students about the intended type and currently makes the provided solution code fail to compile.
issues.suggestedFix: Make attribute types consistent. Recommended minimal fix: change numberOfInscribedStudents in the solution from long to int (update its field declaration, getter/setter return/parameter types, and toString formatting) so it matches the UML in the problem statement and keep getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. Alternatively, if large inscribed counts are intended, update the problem statement UML and method signatures to use long consistently and change getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return long (and update template/solution accordingly).
